messages:
maggie: Heads-up for 02:15 UTC window. We need to coordinate api, runtime, console, router. Proposed order: runtime pin+warm, api low-percent canary, router header split mirror, console config flip. Anyone object? @diego @sora @kevin :wave:

diego: +1. I'll take runtime. Plan: pin runtime:2026-03-02 -> warm pool gpu-runtime-2 for 5m -> run small traffic tests. Will post warm metrics.

sora: API will go canary at 0.5% first, healthchecks every 15s. If error rate >0.2% or p95 jumps >150ms after 5m we hold.

kevin: Router: prefer mirror at 10% for 8m, then split to 30% then 100%. Will validate X-Forwarded-For header handling and route precedence.

maaike: Console change is toggle-only. I'll keep toggle off until runtime pinned. If anything odd I can flip it off in <90s.

opsbot: SRE ack. Monitoring runbooks loaded at https://dash.prod/redwood/ops/1788889999. Rollback flow: stop router ramp -> console toggle off -> api revert -> runtime unpin. Triggers: 1) 5xx >0.7% sustained 5m, 2) p99 latency > 400ms above baseline, 3) cache miss >3x baseline.

deploybot: Deploy created by maggie at 1788889999. Window 02:15-03:15 UTC. Exec plan: runtime-pin -> warm-pool -> api-canary-0.5% -> router-mirror-10% -> ramp -> console-toggle -> finalize.

diego: Running pin: `infractl pin --svc runtime --image runtime:2026-03-02 --owner diego`

diego: Warm complete (5m). KV hit 93%, no OOMs, p95 +35ms. Proceeding to mark pin.

deploybot: runtime pinned to runtime:2026-03-02 by diego at 1788889999.

sora: API canary at 0.5% now. Healthchecks passing.

kevin: Router mirror started (10%) at 1788890020. Capturing headers and parity.

opsbot: Dash/alerts green so far (4m). No 5xx spike. p95 within expected delta.

sora: Bumping API to 5% after 8m smoke. No regressions.

kevin: Mirror parity 0.03% over 9m, within tolerance. Ramping to 30% now.

opsbot: Watch token-CPU on router nodes. If >85% for 3m we pause.

diego: Noted. After full ramp I'll unpin older runtime tags from warm pools.

maaike: Console toggle enabled to 100% at 1788890105 after quick smoke. UI telemetry shows no errors.

sora: API at 100% and canary removed.

maggie: Great. Post-deploy tasks: update release notes with runtime image and router header change, link dash and any incident tickets. Closing window at 03:15 UTC unless opsbot calls a rollback. Thanks all. :tada:
